en: Job 13

p.src: 1  “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.

en: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.
u.src: 1  “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.

p.src: 2  What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.

en: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.
u.src: 2  What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.

p.src: 3  “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.

en: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.
u.src: 3  “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.

p.src: 4  But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.

en: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.
u.src: 4  But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.

p.src: 5  Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.

en: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.
u.src: 5  Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.

p.src: 6  Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.

en: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.
u.src: 6  Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.

p.src: 7  Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?

en: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?
u.src: 7  Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?

p.src: 8  Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?

en: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?
u.src: 8  Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?

p.src: 9  Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?

en: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?
u.src: 9  Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?

p.src: 10  He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.

en: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.
u.src: 10  He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.

p.src: 11  Won’t his majesty make you afraid and his dread fall on you?

en: Won’t his majesty make you afraid and his dread fall on you?
u.src: 11  Won’t his majesty make you afraid and his dread fall on you?

p.src: 12  Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.

en: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.
u.src: 12  Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.

p.src: 13  “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.

en: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.
u.src: 13  “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.

p.src: 14  Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?

en: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?
u.src: 14  Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?

p.src: 15  Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.

en: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
u.src: 15  Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.

p.src: 16  This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.

en: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.
u.src: 16  This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.

p.src: 17  Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.

en: Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.
u.src: 17  Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.

p.src: 18  See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.

en: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.
u.src: 18  See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.

p.src: 19  Who is he who will contend with me? For then I would hold my peace and give up the spirit.

en: Who is he who will contend with me? For then I would hold my peace and give up the spirit.
u.src: 19  Who is he who will contend with me? For then I would hold my peace and give up the spirit.

p.src: 20  “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:

en: “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:
u.src: 20  “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:

p.src: 21  withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.

en: withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.
u.src: 21  withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.

p.src: 22  Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.

en: Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.
u.src: 22  Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.

p.src: 23  How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.

en: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.
u.src: 23  How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.

p.src: 24  Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?

en: Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?
u.src: 24  Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?

p.src: 25  Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?

en: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?
u.src: 25  Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?

p.src: 26  For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.

en: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.
u.src: 26  For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.

p.src: 27  You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,

en: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,
u.src: 27  You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,

p.src: 28  though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.

en: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.
u.src: 28  though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.
